stop_condition: Every D3 deliverable (grilling-record subcommand incl. validation ladder and live vendor_hash recompute; MANIFEST.md recorded hash + vendored-skills section 13 with META-10; design-record GRILLING-PRECONDITION incl. parent-epic path and --no-grilling bypass) is traced to a running assertion with a paired negative control, the 27/24/3 denominator is independently verified against the tree, both flagged judgment calls (existence-only semantics; forgery-disclosure framing) are ruled on with evidence, and no critical/high finding remains in qa-gate.sh new code paths.

findings.evidence: Measured in an isolated fixture (cd fixture && bd init, CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR set): a hand-posted comment reading exactly GRILLING v1 totally informal, no counters, no vendor_hash SATISFIES the precondition — design-record returned status=recorded. The shipped reader (_grilling_comment_on, qa-gate.sh:6152) validates nothing beyond startswith(GRILLING v1 ). Yet the rounds_not_integer error text claims the counters land in a machine prefix which the precondition reader parses as [0-9]+ and that a malformed value writes a record no reader can tell from absent; docs/HOOKS.md repeats the [0-9]+ claim. Both statements are false of the shipped reader: no reader parses the counters, and a malformed/counter-less record reads as PRESENT, not absent. Anchoring itself verified sound: a prose comment merely CONTAINING GRILLING v1 mid-text still refused grilling_record_missing (measured, same fixture).
findings.description: Prose describes an enforcement that does not exist — the class this repo treats as a defect (e2j is the standing example). Writer-side validation is real and correct, so the failure direction stays closed at the writer; but the effective forgery bar for GRILLING v1 is 12 prefix characters, lower than every sibling reader (design-satisfied re-derives the artifact hash and matches design_hash; approve binds change_set_hash; completion binds payload_sha). Cheap fix does both jobs at once: tighten _grilling_comment_on to match the full writer grammar (rounds=[0-9]+ ... vendor_hash=[0-9a-f]{64}) — backward-compatible since the only real writer already guarantees it — or correct the two prose sites.

findings.evidence: Measured on this macOS host: ln -sf <dir> <existing-symlink-to-dir> dereferences and creates a stray link INSIDE the real target (reproduced in scratch). Unreachable today: mk_fixture mints a fresh mktemp -d root per call and takes no root parameter, so the destination never pre-exists; grep found zero component-tier writes under any vendor path; cleanup rm -rf does not traverse symlinks.
findings.description: ln -sfn (portable across BSD/GNU) would close the latent hazard if anyone later adds a root parameter or re-init path. The symlink-into-repo shape otherwise matches the tier established convention (every .claude/scripts/*.sh is already symlinked to the real repo).

findings.evidence: get_parent_epic returns the DIRECT parent only. This repo mints grandchild ids (e.g. claude-workflow-plugin-fkm.1.11): a grilling recorded on the top epic is invisible to a grandchild task whose direct parent is the intermediate task.
findings.description: Matches the documented contract (task OR ITS PARENT EPIC) and the spec tests exactly that; worth one sentence in docs/HOOKS.md if deep hierarchies ever carry design phases, since the remediation message will correctly name the two usable targets.
